_note: Runtime strings for the modules under www/shared/, merged into every page's i18n block by src/components/i18n.njk. Page-specific runtime strings live in that page's own content file under `runtime`. \n in a value is a real line break in the rendered string, not markup.

runtime.chat.title: Talk to creator
runtime.chat.opener:
Hey! Hope you’re having fun 🙂

Found a bug, got an idea, or want more categories or games? Tell me — let me fix it for you.
runtime.chat.too-fast: One moment, that was a little too fast.
runtime.chat.too-many: That is a lot of messages for one day. Try again tomorrow.
runtime.chat.send-failed: Could not send. Please try again.
runtime.auth.title: Sign in
runtime.auth.sub: Sign in to keep your song groups and reuse them anytime.
runtime.auth.fine: We only store your email and the song groups you create. You can delete your account anytime.
runtime.auth.check-inbox: Check your inbox for a sign-in link.
runtime.auth.err-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
runtime.auth.del-body: This permanently deletes your account and all your song groups. This can't be undone.
runtime.auth.del-err-resignin: For security, sign out and sign in again, then delete.
runtime.auth.del-err-generic: Could not delete your account. Please try again.
runtime.lang.switch-body: The whole game will be in {lang}: the words and the buttons. Everyone in a room plays in the same language.
